name: anchor_bead
doc: The merge anchor a review, rework, finding or validation child names (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A listing names it on each bead, and prstatus's in-flight set reads it.

name: branch
doc: The source branch a work bead's change is on, which the work formula's workspace-setup writes (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]). A bead carrying it is in flight.

name: epic_boundaries
doc: What an epic's work is not (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_closure_condition
doc: An epic's closure checks (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_handle
doc: An epic's 3-5 word handle (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_hypothesis
doc: An epic's one-sentence hypothesis (docs/epics.md). An epic under an epic that carries none is a Delivery.

name: epic_indicators
doc: An epic's leading indicators (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling
doc: The latest ruling on an epic's hypothesis: continue, shift or close (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling_at
doc: When the operator made the latest ruling on an epic.

name: epic_ruling_reason
doc: Why the latest ruling on an epic was made, written with it.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready
doc: The pool or agent an armed bead is slung to once nothing holds it. Its presence is the arm.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_args
doc: The arm's extra sling arguments, as a JSON array.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_at
doc: When the bead was armed, in RFC 3339 UTC.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_by
doc: Who armed the bead.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_fail_count
doc: The sling attempts made on the arm, as an integer string.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_reason
doc: Why the bead was armed, as free text.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_slung
doc: The arm's sling marker: slinging@<time> while an attempt is in flight, slung@<time> once it is proven.

name: gc.formula_contract
doc: The formula contract a root was poured under. A root reading graph.v2 is a run's root.

name: gc.input_convoy_id
doc: The input convoy a graph.v2 workflow root was poured over. The convoy tracks the bead the run works, and the bead a live run works is in flight once the run has passed load-context. A root without it works the bead its gc.var.issue names.

name: gc.kind
doc: The runtime's kind of a bead. A root reading workflow is a run's root.

name: gc.notify_when_ready
doc: The named agent a notice is owed to once nothing holds the bead assigned to it. Its presence is the arm.

name: gc.root_bead_id
doc: The workflow root a step was poured under.

name: gc.routed_to
doc: The pool, agent or person a bead is routed to, written by lifecycle.sh's --route and by the script or formula that owns the bead's dispatch (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, ROUTE and [metadata.runtime_owned]).

name: gc.step_ref
doc: The formula step a step bead carries out, as <formula>.<step>. A live run with an open step whose ref ends in .load-context has not passed load-context.

name: gc.var.issue
doc: The bead a classic molecule's issue variable names, which a root that names no input convoy works. A root whose input convoy tracks another bead works none.

name: gc.work_outcome
doc: A work bead's self-reported disposition, no-op or shipped, whose meaning is the runtime's (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]).

name: merge_result
doc: The anchor's lifecycle state, which lifecycle.sh, through gctk lifecycle, writes on every transition (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [machine] and [states]). A bead carrying it is in flight. A listing names it on each bead, so a reader tells an anchor whose pull request is open.

name: pr_number
doc: The number of the anchor's open pull request, which pr-open.sh writes when it opens and pr-facts.sh copies onto rework children (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]).

name: pr_url
doc: The URL of the anchor's open pull request, written with pr_number (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]).

name: rejection_reason
doc: Why the bead's last attempt bounced, which the refinery writes (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]). A bead carrying it is in flight.

name: rig_check.lint
doc: The published copy of a recorded check's result, which `gctk rig <check> --publish-bead <bead>` writes on the bead its caller names: the record the call answered with, as one JSON object of check, result, scope (absent on a lint or typecheck run), commit, tree, exit_code, duration_ms, runner, recorded_at and command. gctk writes it only once the record store holds the result it copies, after recording a result or answering from a record. No pack path reads it: the record under the rig clone's git common directory answers a later call. Absent means no call published that check to the bead. Never cleared: the next publish replaces it. Its commit is the one the check ran at: the head the call answered for, or, for a full-suite test pass answered through the tree, an earlier commit with the same tree.

name: task_kind
doc: The bead's role, which the writer of each of the pack's kinds sets at creation (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A listing reads it for whether the bead is a standing record (services/gctk/standing).
